title: BC Telemetry Buddy – 84 commits later..
summary: BC Telemetry Buddy evolved from a proof of concept to a production-ready tool for analyzing Business Central telemetry. The v1.0.0 release transformed it from a bundled extension into modular components, added AI-powered chat features for data discovery and analysis, and implemented comprehensive testing and CI/CD pipelines.
key_points: Architecture refactored to separate the VS Code extension from an optional MCP server NPM package, allowing flexible deployment and usage scenarios
Discovery-first approach with event catalog browsing, schema discovery tools, and ready-made KQL patterns to simplify telemetry exploration
AI-powered chat participant and specialized chat modes that handle both simple data queries and complex performance analysis automatically
Multi-profile support added to handle multiple telemetry endpoints, with a setup wizard to guide configuration
Matured to production quality with 737 tests covering critical paths, 84.87% code coverage, automated CI/CD pipelines, and anonymous usage telemetry

quotes.text: In the last 4 weeks, my BC Telemetry Buddy went from "nice demo" to "this might actually be getting somewhere".
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the rapid maturation of the tool from concept to production readiness

quotes.text: The extension now runs completely standalone: commands & KQL go straight to Azure/Kusto. No MCP, no extra process, just VS Code and your telemetry.
quotes.why_it_matters: Key architectural change that simplifies deployment and usage options for users
